intro.en: Diwali shopping for the family. Everything must arrive by {deadline_day} November, and items come to our home unless I say otherwise.

item_self.en: For me: the highest-rated {cat_self} in size {size_self} and {colour_self} under ₹{price_self}{addr_self}.

item_father.en: For Papa: the highest-rated {cat_father} in size {size_father} and {colour_father} under ₹{price_father}{addr_father}.

item_mother.en: For Mummy: the highest-rated {cat_mother} in size {size_mother} and {colour_mother} under ₹{price_mother}{addr_mother}.

item_sister.en: For Didi: the highest-rated {cat_sister} in size {size_sister} and {colour_sister} under ₹{price_sister}{addr_sister}, as long as Mummy's and Didi's items together stay within ₹{pair_budget}.

exchange.en: Also exchange the {ex_cat} from my last order for size {ex_size}, same colour.

coupon.en: Use the coupon that gives the biggest discount.

checkout.en: Pay with my ICICI credit card ending {card} and choose the {slot} delivery slot.

nani.en: , delivered to Nani's house in Pune
